description: Get complete daily astronomical data for any lat/lng and date from SunriseSunset.io. Returns sunrise, sunset, dawn, dusk, first/last light, solar noon, golden hour, day length, nautical twilight, current sun altitude and azimuth, moonrise, moonset, moon phase name, moon illumination percentage, and lunar phase value (0–1 cycle). Supports "today", "tomorrow", or any YYYY-MM-DD date. Timezone auto-detected from coordinates or specify an IANA name. Time format: 12h, 24h, or Unix timestamps. No auth required; free commercial use.

date.description: Date to query: "today", "tomorrow", or ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-01-15). Defaults to today.

lat.description: Latitude of the target location (-90 to 90). Positive = North, Negative = South.

lng.description: Longitude of the target location (-180 to 180). Positive = East, Negative = West.

time_format.description: Time output format: "0"=12-hour AM/PM (e.g. 5:26:02 AM), "1"=24-hour (e.g. 05:26:02), "2"=Unix timestamp seconds. Defaults to "0".

timezone.description: IANA timezone name for output times (e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo). Auto-detected from lat/lng if omitted.

name: sunrisesunset.astronomy.daily

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: SunriseSunset — Daily Sun & Moon Times
